_comment: Declared accuracy targets for the reference-author benchmark, checked by `stylometry accuracy-gate`.
These are the requested 95% goal expressed as measurable quantities. They are deliberately stricter
than the benchmark's own predeclared gates in PROTOCOL (80% balanced accuracy), which exist to judge
whether the pilot is worth continuing rather than whether the method is trustworthy.
Accuracy is gated together with unknown-author false acceptance, because a rule that accepts every
candidate scores well on accuracy alone while being useless on a text whose author is not in the set.
A target is met only when the entire 95% interval clears it; an interval straddling it is inconclusive.
No target here says anything about scripture: the benchmark measures catalogued modern and ancient
authors, and a result on it does not transfer to texts whose authorship is the open question.
goal: 95% author accuracy on held-out works by known authors
